'''Pod 1977''' was a [[Escape pod/Legends|life pod]] jettisoned from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']].

==History==
As Master Plo Koon's fleet neared the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' mystery weapon, the starship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], fired its massive [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] at ''Triumphant'', removing all the craft's defenses and making it vulnerable to ''Malevolence''{{'s}} lasers. As Koon's ship was bombarded with laser fire, all of its escape pods were jettisoned, including Pod 1977. Later, as the pod floated through space, it was breached by [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] from a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|pod hunter]], killing all those inside.

==Behind the scenes==
This pod was named after the year [[1977]], when [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] was released.
